backup.fail: Something went wrong. Your data was not changed
backup.help: When you open the app or change data, a backup runs in the background if 12+ hours have passed, keeping the latest {{count}} snapshots. When signed in, it also goes to acacia_backup_v2.json in your Drive.
backup.restoreConfirm:
Restore your personal data to the backup from {{time}}?
Your current data is saved as a "Before restore" snapshot first. Shared spaces follow the cloud and are not restored.

backup.unchanged: Your data matches the latest backup, so no new backup is needed

declined.body: If you don't agree, you can't use ACACIA. Until you agree, ACACIA will not start Google sign-in, location, automatic backups or cloud sync.
declined.leave: If you don't want to use it, just close this tab. If you change your mind, tap “Agree and start” below.
declined.title: You need to agree to use ACACIA

intro.first: Welcome to ACACIA. Before you start, please read the Privacy Policy and the Third-party licenses below. By tapping “Agree and start”, you confirm that you have read and agree to them.
intro.updated: Since you last agreed, we have updated: {{docs}}. Please read again and agree to keep using ACACIA. Your data is not affected.

consent.note: Your agreement is saved only in this browser on this device. You will be asked again if you clear browser data or switch devices.

title.first: Please read and agree before you start
title.updated: Our documents have been updated. Please read and agree again

consent.versions: Privacy Policy version {{privacy}} · Third-party licenses version {{licenses}}.

deleteData.cloudOff: You are not signed in, so only data on this device will be deleted. To delete cloud data too, sign in with Google above first.
deleteData.cloudOn: Signed in to Google: your personal sync file, backup file, and the shared space files you created in the "ACACIA Everyday" Drive folder will also be deleted, and you will be signed out. Spaces created by others are only left, not deleted.
deleteData.confirmCloud:
Delete all ACACIA data?
This removes data and backups on this device, plus your ACACIA personal file, backup and the shared spaces you created in Google Drive, then signs you out. This cannot be undone.
deleteData.confirmLocal: Delete all ACACIA data and automatic backups on this device? This cannot be undone.
deleteData.done: All data on this device has been deleted
deleteData.doneCloud: Deleted ACACIA data on this device and in Google Drive, and signed out
deleteData.fail: Delete failed and your data was not changed. Check your connection and try again.
deleteData.help: Erases all data, automatic backups and preferences on this device. This cannot be undone, so export JSON first.
deleteData.title: Delete all data

search.hint: Search personal events, shared events, and ledger entries
search.title: Search

settings.billingDayHelp: By default a cycle runs from the 10th to the 9th of the next month. If a month is shorter (e.g. the 31st in February), the last day is used.
settings.dataHelp: Export your personal data (events, ledger, settings) as JSON, or import JSON from the old ACACIA (events and ledger only). Your current data is backed up first.
settings.icsBusy: Include members' busy times (shown only as "busy")
settings.icsHelp: Creates a standard .ics file you can import into Apple Calendar, Google Calendar and more (trash not included).
settings.importConfirm: Importing replaces your personal events and ledger (joined shared spaces are kept). Continue?
settings.title: Settings

spaces.busyHelp: Only time ranges (past 7 to next 90 days) and hashed IDs are synced — never titles or notes. Others only see "busy"; you still see your own titles. Turning this off removes your busy times.
spaces.busyToggle: Show my personal events as busy time
spaces.createHelp: A shared space is saved as a file in your Google Drive. Invite family or friends by email to edit events together. Your ledger is never shared.
spaces.failed: Something went wrong. Check your connection and Google sign-in, then try again.
spaces.inviteFailed: Invite failed. Check the email and that you created this space.
spaces.inviteHelp: Enter their Google account email; they'll get a Google Drive share notice. After signing in, they tap "Join shared space" and pick this file.
spaces.inviteHelpMember: Only the creator can invite new members (the shared file lives in their Google Drive).
spaces.joinFailed: Could not open this space. Make sure your Google account was invited.
spaces.leaveConfirm: Leave "{{name}}"? Your busy times will be removed; the shared file itself is not deleted.
spaces.name: Space name
spaces.nativeNote: Shared spaces are not available in the iOS app yet. Please use the web version.
spaces.revoked: This shared space is no longer accessible (sharing may have been removed or the file deleted). Other calendars keep syncing.
spaces.signInFirst: Sign in with Google to create or join shared spaces.

sync.error: Sync failed. Your data is saved on this device
sync.help: After signing in, your data is stored in the "ACACIA Everyday" folder in your own Google Drive (drive.file access only — we cannot see your other files), so it follows you to other devices.
sync.mismatchConfirm: Clear this device and use this account
sync.mismatchHelp: This device still has events or ledger entries from another Google account. To keep the two accounts apart, sync is paused. You can export JSON in Settings first, then switch.
sync.nativeNotice: The iOS app does not support Google sign-in yet. Only on-device data and iCloud backup apply; use the web version for Google Drive sync.
sync.nativeStatus: Saved on this iPhone only (included in iCloud backup)
sync.needsPermissionHelp: The Google Drive permission box wasn't checked when you signed in, so sync can't run. Tap “Grant access”, check that permission in the Google window, and continue.
sync.signIn: Sign in with Google to sync
sync.signOutConfirm: Sign out of Google? Your data stays on this device.
sync.title: Cloud sync

trash.help: Deleted events (including shared spaces) are kept for 30 days and can be restored. After that they are permanently deleted.
trash.purgeConfirm: Permanently delete "{{title}}"? This cannot be undone.
trash.title: Recently deleted
